summary: Round 4 (Navigate button, destinations, late-alert recipients, coverage map) tested end to end. Backend: 15 of 16 pytest checks pass; vitest 157/157 and typecheck pass. The only failure: an invalid startDate on /trips/offline-locations returns 500 (/trips does the same, so it predates this round). Dashboard: the destination modal saves, clears, is prefilled and persists after reload. The Users late-alert checkbox persists after reload (dispatcher set back to false). The Coverage map loads OSM tiles (all 200) with 3 markers, a working popup and summary, and the from/to filters work. Driver app (390x844 and 375x667): Home destination card, address and note show. Navigate shows Google and Waze (no Apple on web) and Cancel. The tabs open google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=... and waze.com/ul?q=...&navigate=yes. ActiveTrip (michael, given a temporary TEST_ destination) shows the card, the screen scrolls and End Trip is reachable and goes to End Trip. The destination still shows offline. Trips page regression passes (offline filter gives 3 rows, photos load as blobs). One real bug: a same-day From/To range on Coverage (and Trips) returns nothing because endDate is midnight and the end of the range is exclusive.

minor.issue: endDate becomes new Date('YYYY-MM-DD'), which is midnight UTC, so trips on the 'To' day are left out. From=To=2026-11-19 returns 0 points, although all 3 points are on 2026-11-19. GET /api/trips (Trips page) has the same issue. Ref: tripController.ts:119 and :75
Returns 500 'Failed to fetch offline locations' instead of 400 (Invalid Date reaches Sequelize). /api/trips behaves the same. Ref: tripController.ts:118

ui_bugs.issue: The 'To' date is exclusive, so picking the same day for From and To shows '0 no-signal points' (backend endDate issue).

issues: toggleAlerts reverts silently when the PUT fails, with no error message for the admin (Users.tsx:98-105)
Escape does not close the modal
The Drivers Destination column shows only the address, not the note
Points at the same spot overlap (2 Phoenix points at 33.4,-112 look like 1 marker), so the count does not match the dots. Consider clustering or a count badge.
The destination only refreshes when the screen gains focus. A change made by the dispatcher while the driver is on Home does not appear until they leave and come back (no socket or polling).

action_items: Make endDate inclusive in getOfflineLocations and getAllTrips, e.g. Op.lt the next day, or end-of-day when the value is date-only
Validate startDate/endDate (return 400 for an invalid date) in getOfflineLocations and getAllTrips
Optional: show an error toast when the late-alerts toggle fails; let Escape close DestinationModal; show the note in the Drivers Destination column
critical_code_review_comments: setDriverDestination: validation, trim, 500-char cap, and clearing the note with the address all look right. The route is protected by requireUser; drivers get 403 (verified).
my-destination is registered before /:id with requireDriver (admin gets 403, no token gets 401). Verified.
DESTINATION_KEY is in clearOfflineCache, which runs on logout, so a cached destination does not carry over to the next driver.
The late alert service queries User.findAll({lateTripAlerts:true}) and returns early when nobody is subscribed. The ALTER adds the column NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE.
tripController.ts is 741 lines (over 700); consider splitting it.
Seed trip for michael started 2/8/2026, so ActiveTrip shows a duration of 6818:59:19 (an hours-only format with no days). Old seed data, not from this round.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested flows work; 1 date-filter bug

seed_data_creation: None kept. Temporarily set maria (id 2) and michael (id 5) destinations to TEST_ values and cleared them (both were null before). Toggled dispatcher lateTripAlerts and set it back to false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login returns accessToken, not token. The driver app keeps Home mounted under ActiveTrip, so use :visible on navigate-button. For offline tests do not use page.go_back() (it reloads the page offline and shows a blank screen); use the header back button [aria-label*=back]. Dashboard drivers have desktop and mobile testIDs (driver-destination-<id> and driver-destination-mobile-<id>).
rca_of_issue: Same-day coverage range: Coverage sends endDate='2026-11-19'. The backend runs new Date('2026-11-19'), which is 2026-11-19T00:00Z, and Op.lte on startTime excludes every trip later that day.
